capsuleTopic.title: Bridegroom of blood
capsuleTopic.subtitle: Exodus 4:24–26 · decisive action · unresolved referents
capsuleTopic.orientation: Begin with what the three verses explicitly say. Then widen to family context, the firstborn warning, covenant circumcision, later Exodus, and a bounded journey parallel without using any of them as an automatic answer key.
capsuleTopic.trailPrompt: Keep actions, speakers, pronouns, sequence, and silence visible. Let related Scripture sharpen the questions without pretending the passage supplies every answer.
